symptom: `mxcli diff-local --ref HEAD` took 1,257 s (21 min) on a project of ~7,700 units with 851 changed and 851 new microflows; about 0.74 s per changed microflow (mendixlabs/mxcli#1873).
cause: microflowBsonToMDL and nanoflowBsonToMDL called buildNameLookups for every rendering -- both sides of every changed flow -- and it built its ID-to-name maps with ListMicroflows and ListNanoflows, decoding every flow of the project each time. 99% of the run.
fix: Build the maps once per diff-local run (ctx.Cache.diffNames, set and cleared by diffLocal, which writes nothing), from the flows' headers instead of decoded flows. Reproduction on 5,373 units, 100 modified + 20 new microflows: 60.4 s -> 0.73 s, byte-identical output.
insight: The reporter's guess was git: one `git show` per unit. Measured, 100 of them take 0.28 s on Linux; the profile had one function at 99%. A per-item cost that looks like process overhead can be a project-sized rebuild hidden two calls below the renderer. The per-unit git calls may still matter on Windows, where spawning a process costs far more -- not measured.
test: mdl/executor/cmd_diff_local_name_lookups_test.go: a diff of five changed flows builds the lookups once and still renders both sides with calls resolved (10 builds with the memo removed); the header-built maps equal the decoded ones, including an excluded flow and a nanoflow; nothing is kept outside a run.
